description: adversarial-review skill — realistic critical review requests

tests.description: [smoke] synthesis — verifies outputs and renders judgment

vars.scenario:
- One reviewer output is missing, and two reviewers produced overlapping medium findings.
- The final answer must synthesize, deduplicate, and judge the findings.

tests.description: native subagents — independent reviewers without model CLIs

vars.scenario:
- The user says: "run adversarial review on this PR diff."
- The lead agent is Codex.
- Native same-model subagents and other-model CLIs are available.

tests.description: large diff — selects 3 lens reviewers and runs them in parallel

vars.scenario:
- The diff changes 8 files and 420 lines.
- The diff is large enough to need the full review treatment.
- The user expects a normal adversarial-review result.

tests.description: unavailable delegation — report incomplete review without CLI fallback

vars.scenario:
- Native subagent tools are unavailable.
- Other-model CLIs are installed.
- The user requests an adversarial review before shipping.
